question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
-- Final query
WITH first_payment_per_customer AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) AS earliest_payment_date
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
first_rental_details AS (
    SELECT 
        fp.customer_id,
        f.rating
    FROM first_payment_per_customer fp
    JOIN payment p ON fp.customer_id = p.customer_id AND fp.earliest_payment_date = p.payment_date
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT payment_id FROM payment 
        WHERE customer_id = fp.customer_id AND payment_date = fp.earliest_payment_date
        ORDER BY payment_id LIMIT 1
    ) p1 ON p.payment_id = p1.payment_id
    JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_amounts AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount_spent
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_rentals AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COUNT(rental_id) AS total_rentals
    FROM rental
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    frd.rating AS first_movie_rating,
    AVG(ca.total_amount_spent) AS avg_total_amount,
    AVG(cr.total_rentals - 1) AS avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_rental_details frd
JOIN customer_amounts ca ON frd.customer_id = ca.customer_id
JOIN customer_rentals cr ON frd.customer_id = cr.customer_id
GROUP BY frd.rating
ORDER BY frd.rating
